footer.credit: MedLens is an independent, patient-friendly reader for FDA drug labels. Label data is provided by the U.S. National Library of Medicine <link>DailyMed</link> service.
footer.disclaimer: This information is for educational purposes only and is not a substitute for the advice of a healthcare professional. Always read the full label and talk to your doctor or pharmacist before taking any medication.

home.title: Understand your medicine in a few clear sections.
home.subtitle: MedLens turns the official FDA drug label into patient-friendly sections: what it's for, how to take it, warnings, side effects, and more.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search a medicine by name (e.g. ibuprofen, Lipitor)

plain.title: Plain-language
plain.body: Labels are rewritten with patient-friendly headings (e.g. 'How to take it' instead of 'Dosage and administration').

private.title: Private by design
private.body: Your saved medications stay on this device. Nothing is sent to any server besides the FDA's DailyMed service.

current.title: Always current
current.body: Data comes live from DailyMed v2 and reflects the latest FDA-approved label for every product.

search.prompt: Type a medicine name above to begin.
search.empty: No medicines matched {q}. Check the spelling, or try a generic or brand name.

ndc.heading: Look up a medicine by its NDC code
ndc.intro: The National Drug Code (NDC) is printed on most US medication packaging. It's usually three groups of numbers, like 0002-4462-30.
ndc.invalid: That doesn't look like a valid NDC. Enter 8–13 digits (e.g. 0002-4462-30).
ndc.labelerMatch: No exact match — showing products from the same labeler:
ndc.empty: No medicines found for that NDC in DailyMed.

scan.heading: Scan your medicine's barcode
scan.intro: Point your camera at the barcode on the medication packaging. We'll try to extract the National Drug Code (NDC) and look it up in DailyMed. Works best on recent Chrome / Edge on Android and on iOS 17+.
scan.privacyNote: Your camera feed is processed entirely on your device — nothing is uploaded.
scan.notSupported: Barcode scanning isn't supported on this browser. You can still type the NDC manually on the <link>NDC lookup page</link>.

drug.noPatientSections: We couldn't extract patient-friendly sections from this label. You can still read the full label on DailyMed using the link above.
drug.contentLanguageNote: The clinical content below is shown in the official English text from the FDA label. We don't auto-translate medical information — please ask your pharmacist if anything is unclear.
drug.mediaIntro: Photos of the product and/or packaging supplied by the manufacturer.

myMeds.heading: My medications
myMeds.intro: The list below is stored only on this device — we never send it to a server.
myMeds.empty: You haven't saved any medications yet. Open a drug label and tap Save to My meds.

errors.heading: Something went wrong
errors.body: We couldn't load that page. The DailyMed service may be temporarily unavailable, or the page you were looking for doesn't exist.
errors.notFoundBody: We couldn't find that medicine in DailyMed.
errors.globalBody: Please try again. If this keeps happening, open the DailyMed site directly.

offline.heading: You're offline
offline.body: MedLens needs an internet connection to fetch the latest drug labels from DailyMed. Your saved medications on <link>My meds</link> are still available.
